title: mitu hub beta reisyou bot
script:
-- 冷笑ボット | Roblox Auto Chat

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BlizTBr/scripts/main/Orion%20X"))()

-- 指定フレーズ
local PHRASES = {
    "うおw😅",
    "どわー笑😅",
    "ったく…w😅",
    "かっこよw😅",
    "えぐー！笑😅",
    "冗談ですやん！！w🫲😅",
    "きちーww😅🤚",
    "おもろいなあ！ww😅👍",
    "ど、どした？笑😅",
    "ちょw1回落ち着けw落ち着けw😅",
    "ええてw😅🤚",
    "ちょwお前必死やんww😅",
    "すごいなあキミww😅👍", 
    "ちょw怒んなやw😅",
}

local Settings = {
    Enabled = false,
    Interval = 3,      -- 秒
    Random = true,   -- true=ランダム / false=順番
    Index = 1,
}

local function Notify(t, c)
    OrionLib:MakeNotification({Name = t, Content = c, Time = 2})
end

local function SendChat(msg)
    if not msg or msg == "" then return false end

    -- 新チャット (TextChatService)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local channel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if channel then
                channel:SendAsync(msg)
                return
            end
        end
        error("legacy")
    end)

    if ok then return true end

    -- 旧チャット
    local ok2 = pcall(function()
        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        local say = events and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
        if say then
            say:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
    return ok2
end

local function NextPhrase()
    if Settings.Random then
        return PHRASES[math.random(1, #PHRASES)]
    end
    local msg = PHRASES[Settings.Index]
    Settings.Index = Settings.Index + 1
    if Settings.Index > #PHRASES then Settings.Index = 1 end
    return msg
end

local botTask
local function StartBot()
    if botTask then return end
    Settings.Enabled = true
    Notify("冷笑ボット", "開始")
    botTask = task.spawn(function()
        while Settings.Enabled do
            local msg = NextPhrase()
            SendChat(msg)
            task.wait(Settings.Interval)
        end
        botTask = nil
    end)
end

local function StopBot()
    Settings.Enabled = false
    if botTask then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(botTask) end)
        botTask = nil
    end
    Notify("冷笑ボット", "停止")
end

-- UI
local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({
    Name = "冷笑ボット",
    HidePremium = false,
    SaveConfig = false,
    ConfigFolder = "reisyou_bot"
})

local Tab = Window:MakeTab({Name = "メイン", Icon = "rbxassetid://7733960981"})

Tab:AddParagraph("フレーズ", #PHRASES .. " 個登録済み")

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "自動冷笑 ON/OFF",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        if v then StartBot() else StopBot() end
    end
})

Tab:AddToggle({
    Name = "ランダム送信",
    Default = true,
    Callback = function(v) Settings.Random = v end
})

Tab:AddSlider({
    Name = "間隔（秒）",
    Min = 1,
    Max = 15,
    Default = 3,
    Increment = 1,
    Callback = function(v) Settings.Interval = v end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "今すぐ1回送る",
    Callback = function()
        local msg = NextPhrase()
        SendChat(msg)
        Notify("送信", msg)
    end
})

Tab:AddButton({
    Name = "全部順番に1周送る",
    Callback = function()
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, msg in ipairs(PHRASES) do
                if not Settings.Enabled and false then break end
                SendChat(msg)
                task.wait(math.max(Settings.Interval, 1.5))
            end
            Notify("冷笑ボット", "1周完了")
        end)
    end
})

OrionLib:MakeNotification({
    Name = "冷笑ボット",
    Content = "準備完了",
    Time = 3
})
OrionLib:Init()
